records.truthmaker: ContextualMedicineClassificationAssignment specifies an AppliedClassificationEntryRole under a list/scheme/version/jurisdiction context.
records.temporal: Assignment interval and source list version; do not merge two different contextual assignments.
records.positive: An explicit contextClassificationEntry(r,e) with contextual assignment r and AppliedClassificationEntryRole e also entails classificationEntry(r,e).
records.negative: A generic classificationEntry(r,e) alone does not entail contextClassificationEntry(r,e); same lexical classification code is insufficient.
records.cardinality: Parent classificationEntry is exactly one entry per ProductClassificationAssignment; child inherits upper bound 1 via subproperty, but child minimum is NOT entailed. No new child lower bound until author decides whether all contextual assignments use this specific child edge.

records.truthmaker: ContextualMedicineClassificationAssignment relates a ClassifiedMedicinalProductRole when the classified entity is specifically a Product.
records.temporal: Assignment/list/jurisdiction context applies; product identity does not imply global critical/essential status.
records.positive: An explicit contextClassificationProduct(r,p) with Product role p entails generic classificationEntity(r,p).
records.negative: A contextual assignment with a PharmaceuticalSubstance subject is valid in inherited contract and must not be forced to have a Product child edge.
records.cardinality: Parent classificationEntity exactly one ClassifiedEntity; child at most one through parent, optional when classified entity is Substance. No min1 Product edge.

records.truthmaker: EvidenceSupport mediates a SourceRecord that bears EvidenceSourceRecordRole and an Assertion through its separate claim mediation.
records.temporal: Source release/provenance and support validity can differ; a SourceRecord is not itself the claim.
records.positive: Explicit evidenceRecord(r,s) with SourceRecord role s entails evidenceItem(r,s).
records.negative: An EvidenceSupport whose evidence is an ObservationResult remains valid; the parent evidenceItem edge does not entail evidenceRecord.
records.cardinality: Parent EvidenceSupport has exactly one EvidenceItem and exactly one supported assertion; child record is optional and inherits upper bound one. No min1 SourceRecord edge.
